Product introduction

Oil-immersed transformers for distribution and renewable step-up applications up to the 35 kV class. The range includes 12 kV distribution configurations and separate 35 kV step-up configurations for wind, photovoltaic and energy-storage collection networks.

PEI complies with EU Tier 2 requirements under (EU) 2019/1783 and (EU) No 548/2014.

Configuration options

Electrical rating
Select capacity, HV and LV winding voltages, frequency and vector group for the connected network.
Tap arrangement

Winding and monitoring
Copper or aluminium winding configurations and remote-monitoring arrangements address different project requirements.

Project applications

Distribution and renewable collection

Oil-immersed transformers supply urban and rural distribution, industrial loads and renewable-energy collection networks. Capacity, voltage ratio and winding connections follow the connected electrical system.
